injuries.detail: Joe (hip) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Lakers.
Jones posted 18 points (6-14 FG, 0-3 3Pt, 3-3 FT), 10 rebounds, an assist, two steals and two blocks in Wednesday's 100-88 Summer League loss to the Suns.
Harkless signed a two-way contract with the Pistons, Keith Smith of Spotrac.com reports.
Duren will be re-evaluated in two weeks due to a right hamstring strain, Eric Vincent of ClutchPoints.com reports.
Doncic (back) is questionable for Sunday's game against the Pistons.
